Package org.scilab.forge.jlatexmath

Class MacroInfo

java.lang.Object
org.scilab.forge.jlatexmath.MacroInfo
public class MacroInfo extends Object
A command of the formulas: its number of arguments, and what it does. The predefined commands are PredefMacroInfo, which override invoke(org.scilab.forge.jlatexmath.TeXParser, java.lang.String[]); the commands that a formula defines (\newcommand) have a MacroInfo.MacroHandler. There is no reflection (Method.invoke): it does not work in the TeaVM C build.
